title: Riemannian Proximal Sampler, Guan, Balasubramanian & Ma
tldr_zh: MBI+热核双 oracle 的流形高精度采样，O(log(1/ε)) 迭代，可视为 Wasserstein 空间上熵正则黎曼 proximal point 离散化。
tldr_en: Manifold sampling via MBI+heat kernel oracles with O(log(1/ε)) iterations, as discretized entropic Riemannian proximal point on Wasserstein space.
